t: Burns honey to produce power. Honey can be piped in or honey bottles, blocks and buckets can be added in the GUI
燃烧蜂蜜来产生能量。蜂蜜可以通过管道输入，也可以在 GUI 中放入蜂蜜瓶、蜂蜜块和蜂蜜桶。

A Honey Generator accepts two upgrades; A $(l:items/upgrades#productivity)Productivity upgrade$(/l) will lower the honey consumption. $(l:items/upgrades#speed)Speed upgrade$(/l) will increase the...speed.
蜂蜜发电机可接受两种升级：$(l:items/upgrades#productivity)升级：产量$(/l)会降低蜂蜜消耗；$(l:items/upgrades#speed)升级：速度$(/l)会提升……速度。
